column3: The Hebrew says his son without naming Asa; BSB supplies Asa’s name.
The Hebrew names Jehoshaphat as recipient; BSB uses him.
The Hebrew says his heart grew high; BSB interprets this as taking delight.
The Hebrew leaves the sender unnamed; BSB names Jehoshaphat.
The Hebrew repeats Levites after the names; BSB names their status only once.
The Hebrew describes silver as a burden or load and calls the animals flocks; BSB uses tribute and from their flocks.
The Hebrew describes becoming greater up to a height; BSB uses growing stronger and stronger.
The Hebrew says much work; BSB interprets this as vast supplies.
The Hebrew repeats the king as the one stationing men; BSB uses he.
